facts.statement: Job NBL-008-3466 is check-out works at Flat 5, 55 Lantern Quay, Cedarford, ZZ2 4ZZ: repaint, replace burnt bedroom carpet, replace bathroom flooring, repair plug, repair dripping bath tap, repair bathroom shelf.
The property is not tenanted; the ticket was auto-paused for that reason.
Estimate of £1,370.00 (no VAT itemised) from Alder Compliance expressly excludes the carpet: 'Carpet in the main room can stay as it's not that bad'; it includes replacing the bathroom tap.
Second quote obtained at the landlord's request: Kendall £1,700.00 + VAT; Eliza Bennett £1,370.00 with no VAT.
The landlord approved the cheaper option in their own message: 'Please go ahead with Eliza.'
Provider confirmed it would proceed; works were completed and the task moved to Result.
Invoice from Alder Compliance totals £1,190.00 with no tax stated; scope billed is painting, bathroom lino, plug socket and shelf — no carpet and no tap replacement.
Invoice was forwarded to the landlord, with the note that the tap did not need replacing so the cost was below the estimate.
Photo upload was skipped with the recorded reason 'No photos attached'; the invoice also contains no photos.
The landlord confirmed payment of the invoice: 'Ok to pay.'
Both check-out reports record smoke and carbon monoxide detectors as tested — Yes, with no detector comments.
Check-out reports record evidence of water ingress to the bedroom ceiling (pre-existing per inventory) and water damage to bathroom boxing and flooring from shower-area water egress.
The agency closed the request at event-048, immediately after recording that landlord confirmation was still needed (event-047) and before the landlord's confirmation arrived (event-049).
No landlord standing spend cap or standing instruction is on file in the case record; authority for this job rests solely on the landlord's approval at event-038.
